permanent_lessons: Dataset first, then invent a signal, then backtest, then fail, then pick another dataset is no longer acceptable: every experiment starts from a named mispricing mechanism and answers the eleven P&L work-gate fields before any return is computed.

Public, slow, heavily processed information (13F, 13D/G, 8-K, Form 4, fails-to-deliver, XBRL fundamentals, filing behaviour) was priced at or before a legitimate entry in every test; the PUBLIC_SLOW_DISCLOSURE class carries that measured penalty.
Orthogonality is not alpha, interesting data is not alpha, statistical significance without after-cost P&L is not alpha, and historical out-of-sample evidence is not TRUE_FORWARD evidence.

A real structural premium with a worthless timing signal has been seen at least three times (VIX term structure, FX carry, rates carry): every premium-timing test measures its increment over a volatility-matched passive book.

When a family hits its kill rule it is closed: no rename, no sign reversal, no threshold tuning, no horizon change and no rescue feature, unless a specific measured implementation defect prevented the original hypothesis from being tested.

mechanisms.title: SPX tail-hedging demand measured by the Cboe SKEW index, and subsequent 5-session index returns, on history the live skew candidate never saw

census_before_returns.computed: signal-only: no forward return, book or P&L statistic was computed
census_before_returns.preregistered_clause_fired: the census correlation is below 0.30, so whatever this experiment shows it is recorded as NOT informative for REVERSED_SPY_PUT_CALL_SKEW_H5_NEXT_OPEN_V1
census_before_returns.ranking_inputs_revised: live_candidate_decision_value 0.90 -> 0.00 and independence 0.25 -> 0.80: the Cboe 30-day tail skew and the live near-expiry 2 %-OTM put-call spread are different information, measured before any return

pnl_gate.PNL_MECHANISM: Portfolio hedgers buy SPX out-of-the-money puts for crash protection without optimising expected return. When tail-hedging demand is abnormally high, dealers who are short those puts sell index delta and quote a steeper risk-neutral skew (the Cboe SKEW index). The live candidate's evidence says concentrated downside hedging demand precedes LOWER 5-session index returns; the P&L here is a weekly SPY position signed against an abnormally steep SKEW, tested on 1993-2022.
pnl_gate.WHY_MISPRICING_SHOULD_EXIST: Tail-hedging demand is inelastic to price and concentrated among institutions whose objective is drawdown control, and dealers' delta hedges of short puts add selling pressure that is not news about fundamentals; if the skew also carries informed downside positioning, the cash index adjusts slowly because the option market is where that information is expressed first.
pnl_gate.WHY_IT_SHOULD_STILL_EXIST_WHEN_TRADABLE: SKEW is an end-of-day value and the position is entered no earlier than the NEXT session close, so any same-day reaction is forgone; the mechanism must survive a full-session delay, the same entry discipline the live next-open challenger already accepts.
pnl_gate.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_OR_STRUCTURAL_PRES: Structural pressure from inelastic tail-hedging demand and dealer delta hedging, plus derivatives-first expression of downside information; no information advantage over dealers is assumed.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_HOLDING_HORIZON: 5 sessions, non-overlapping weekly decisions, matching the live candidate's frozen horizon so the evidence speaks to the same holding period.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_COST_SURVIVABILITY: One SPY position per week at the canonical 1 bp per side and a 5 bp stress rung: about 104 sides a year costs 1.0-5.2 %/yr at full turnover, so a gross edge below roughly 6 %/yr does not survive the stress rung.
pnl_gate.WHAT_DECISION_THIS_EXPERIMENT_WILL_CHANG: The signal-only census showed the Cboe SKEW z-score is uncorrelated with the live candidate's signal, so this no longer tests the live candidate. It decides whether index-level TAIL-hedging demand, a different information object in the same mechanism class, is an independent SPX return source over thirty years: if it holds, a long-history tail-skew rule becomes a candidate for its own prospective registration; if it fails, index tail-skew timing is closed and the class multiplier lowers the remaining hedging-demand work.
pnl_gate.SUCCESS_PATH_TO_CAPITAL: Qualify on the preregistered 1993-01..2022-07 window under the canonical scorer and inherited multiplicity, freeze the identity, confirm on the untouched 2022-08..2026-08 overlap, then human-gated prospective registration into the existing TRUE_FORWARD machinery; R51 governance and R50 zero-base allocation only after forward evidence.
pnl_gate.KILL_RULE: Kill if the frozen negative-sign weekly book has NW t < 2.0 or net < 1.5 %/yr at 1 bp per side over 1993-01..2022-07; or its sign disagrees in 2 or more of the 4 decade partitions; or it fails BH q=0.10 with the inherited SPY option-surface and SKEW-state tests at p=1. If the census correlation between the SKEW z-score and the SPY OPRA skew z-score over the overlap is below 0.30, the result is recorded as NOT informative for the live candidate whatever it shows.
pnl_gate.TIME_OR_DATA_BUDGET: One and a half working days; owned Cboe SKEW history (R41 _data_cboe, 1990+) refreshed from the free Cboe CDN, and owned Norgate SPY total-return closes; $0 and no purchase.
pnl_gate.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATIVE: Not a variant of REVERSED_SPY_PUT_CALL_SKEW_H5_NEXT_OPEN_V1: a different instrument (SPX index options, 30-day tail), a different construction (the Cboe SKEW risk-neutral skewness, not a 2 %-OTM implied-volatility spread) and a disjoint 1993-2022 window that can neither backfill nor re-identify it. SKEW entered R32_VOLATILITY_RISK_REGIME_BETA_TIMING only inside a monthly composite, VX_CONDITIONAL_SHORT_VOL_R41 only as a VX-spread conditioner and VOLATILITY_EXPECTATIONS_IV_R63 only inside a block for the volatility and rates scopes that failed to reproduce; it was never scored alone against the index at 5 sessions. mechanisms.title: Concentrated hedging demand across equity indices: Nasdaq-100 and Russell 2000 implied volatility rich versus the S&P 500, and subsequent relative index returns

census_before_returns.computed: signal-only: FRED VIXCLS, VXNCLS, RVXCLS fetched free into _data_implied_vol_indices with a sha256 manifest; no forward return, book or P&L statistic was computed
census_before_returns.ranking_inputs_revised: live_candidate_decision_value 0.55 -> 0.00 and independence 0.75 -> 0.85: the relative premium is uncorrelated with the live near-expiry SPY skew signal, so it cannot corroborate that candidate; measured before any return

pnl_gate.PNL_MECHANISM: When hedgers crowd into one index's options, that index's implied volatility rises relative to the S&P 500's by more than its realised volatility justifies. The estate's only surviving candidate says concentrated downside hedging demand precedes weaker returns in the hedged index; applied across indices, a rich relative implied-variance premium in the Nasdaq-100 or Russell 2000 should precede that index underperforming the S&P 500 over the next month, earned by a dollar-neutral spread that carries no market beta.
pnl_gate.WHY_MISPRICING_SHOULD_EXIST: Hedging demand is index-specific (technology-concentrated portfolios hedge the Nasdaq-100, small-cap books hedge the Russell 2000) and dealers delta-hedge each index's options in that index, so relative hedging pressure becomes relative price pressure that cross-index arbitrage does not remove because the option books are not fungible.
pnl_gate.WHY_IT_SHOULD_STILL_EXIST_WHEN_TRADABLE: The implied volatility indices are end-of-day values; the spread is entered at the next close and held a month, so no same-session reaction is claimed, and a relative-value spread is not the outright index-level premium the estate already found worthless to time.
pnl_gate.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_OR_STRUCTURAL_PRES: Structural relative hedging pressure plus derivatives-first expression of index-specific downside risk; no private information.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_COST_SURVIVABILITY: Two legs (QQQ or IWM against SPY, or the matching index futures) rebalanced monthly at 1-2 bp per side per leg with a 5 bp stress rung: under 2.4 %/yr at stress even at full turnover.
pnl_gate.WHAT_DECISION_THIS_EXPERIMENT_WILL_CHANG: The signal-only census showed the relative implied premium is uncorrelated with the live candidate's signal, so it decides only its own question: whether index-specific hedging demand priced in relative implied volatility is a market-neutral return source independent of everything the estate holds. Success opens that source for prospective registration; failure closes relative implied-volatility work and lowers the hedging-demand class through the measured multiplier.
pnl_gate.SUCCESS_PATH_TO_CAPITAL: Qualify on 2004-2019 (FRED VXNCLS 2001+, RVXCLS 2004+) under the canonical scorer, confirm on the untouched 2020-2026 window, human-gated prospective registration of the spread; R51 and R50 only after forward evidence.
pnl_gate.KILL_RULE: Kill if the frozen-sign relative spread book has NW t < 2.0 or net < 1.5 %/yr at 2 bp per side per leg; or the Nasdaq-100 and Russell 2000 legs disagree in sign; or it fails BH q=0.10 at m=2 plus the inherited SPY option-surface tests at p=1; or the relative implied premium has rank correlation above 0.5 with the trailing 21-session relative return (then it is price state, not hedging demand).
pnl_gate.TIME_OR_DATA_BUDGET: Two working days; free FRED VXNCLS and RVXCLS and Cboe VXN/RVX histories, owned Cboe VIX, owned Norgate QQQ, IWM and SPY total-return series; $0.

Every index-level implied test - R32_VOLATILITY_RISK_REGIME_BETA_TIMING, MARKET_IMPLIED_RISK_PREMIA_R35, VOL_TERM_EQUITY_TIMING_R35_R36_R63 and VOLATILITY_EXPECTATIONS_IV_R63 - timed OUTRIGHT index exposure on one volatility level or term structure, never a relative premium across indices in a market-neutral spread. mechanisms.title: Index-versus-constituent correlation risk premium (Cboe COR3M implied correlation minus realised S&P 500 pairwise correlation) and subsequent index returns

census_before_returns.computed: signal-only: free Cboe COR3M/COR1M/DSPX fetched with a sha256 manifest into _data_implied_correlation; strictly trailing 63-session average pairwise correlation of PIT S&P 500 members from the owned R57 panel; no forward return
census_before_returns.pit_caveat: the COR1M/COR3M family replaced the published ICJ/JCJ/KCJ indices (which end 2021-11-19) and its pre-2021 history is a methodology backfill computed from historical option prices; this is disclosed, not treated as a kill, because the inputs were observable and the method is not fitted to returns - the executor must report results separately for the published period
census_before_returns.regime_note: the premium collapsed to about zero after 2019, so a strictly trailing z-score, not the level, is the only admissible construction

pnl_gate.PNL_MECHANISM: Index put buyers pay for protection against stocks falling TOGETHER, so index options embed a correlation risk premium over single-name options. When implied correlation stands far above the correlation constituents actually realise, hedgers are paying an abnormal price for joint-crash insurance, which should compensate an index long for bearing that joint-crash risk over the following month.
pnl_gate.WHY_MISPRICING_SHOULD_EXIST: Correlation risk cannot be diversified by the dealers who sell index options against single-name options, so its price is set by capital-constrained intermediaries and moves with hedging demand rather than with expected correlation alone.
pnl_gate.WHY_IT_SHOULD_STILL_EXIST_WHEN_TRADABLE: COR3M is an end-of-day value and the position is entered at the next close; a monthly compensation for bearing joint-crash risk is a risk transfer, not an informational edge that one session removes.
pnl_gate.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_OR_STRUCTURAL_PRES: Structural: a premium paid by hedgers and intermediated by capital-constrained dealers; no informational edge is claimed.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_COST_SURVIVABILITY: One SPY position change a month at 1 bp per side with a 5 bp stress rung: at most about 1.2 %/yr at stress, so a 3 %/yr gross increment would survive.
pnl_gate.WHAT_DECISION_THIS_EXPERIMENT_WILL_CHANG: If the correlation-premium state carries no increment over a volatility-matched passive long, implied correlation joins the VIX level and term structure as a real premium with a worthless timing signal and index-level implied-state timing is closed for the derivatives domain; if it survives, it is the first index-timing signal built from cross-sectional rather than single-level option information.
pnl_gate.SUCCESS_PATH_TO_CAPITAL: Qualify on 2006-2018 under the canonical scorer against a volatility-matched passive long, confirm on the untouched 2019-2026 window, human-gated prospective registration; R51 and R50 only after forward evidence.
pnl_gate.KILL_RULE: Kill if the signed monthly book's increment over a volatility-matched passive long has NW t < 2.0 or is below 1.5 %/yr net; or it fails BH q=0.10 inheriting the R32, R35, R36 and R63 implied-state timing tests at p=1; or its sign flips between the 2006-2012 and 2013-2018 partitions.
pnl_gate.TIME_OR_DATA_BUDGET: Three working days; free Cboe COR3M history (2006+, no key) and the owned Norgate PIT S&P 500 panel for realised pairwise correlation; $0.
pnl_gate.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATIVE: Implied correlation was never loaded by any estate test (sweep 2026-09-13: zero hits); R33 used only a realised correlation feature inside CROSS_MARKET_PREDICTION_R33_R34. It is an index-versus-constituent object, not the volatility level or term structure prosecuted in MARKET_IMPLIED_RISK_PREMIA_R35, VOL_TERM_EQUITY_TIMING_R35_R36_R63, R32_VOLATILITY_RISK_REGIME_BETA_TIMING or VOLATILITY_EXPECTATIONS_IV_R63, and the shared failure of those tests (a real premium with a worthless timing signal) is exactly what this kill rule's volatility-matched control tests.

mechanisms.title: Gradual diffusion of crude oil shocks into equity index prices

census_before_returns.computed: signal-only: roll-free crude returns, monthly shock distribution and the same-month (past) relation to SPY; no next-month equity return was computed
census_before_returns.data_trap_found: the roll-free WTI futures return (diff of &CL_CCB over prior unadjusted &CL) prints -306 % on 2020-04-20 (negative front-month price), inflating 2013-2026 monthly oil volatility to 0.389; FRED Brent spot carries an EIA publication lag and is not observable at the month-end close; the oil SHOCK is therefore declared on Norgate ICE Brent futures &BRN (1988-06-23.., never negative, minimum 9.75) with the same roll-free return (diff of &BRN_CCB over prior unadjusted &BRN), because only SPY is traded

pnl_gate.PNL_MECHANISM: Crude oil price changes carry information about input costs and consumer demand for the whole corporate sector, but equity investors process that commodity-market information slowly, so a large oil price increase over a month is followed by lower equity index returns the next month (Driesprong, Jacobsen and Maat 2008). The P&L is a monthly SPY or ES position signed against the prior month's oil shock.
pnl_gate.WHY_MISPRICING_SHOULD_EXIST: Specialist commodity traders and generalist equity investors are different clienteles with different attention; the equity market under-weights a signal it does not trade, and cost pass-through reaches reported earnings only one or two reporting periods later.
pnl_gate.WHY_IT_SHOULD_STILL_EXIST_WHEN_TRADABLE: The signal is the COMPLETED prior calendar month's crude return, fully public at the month-end close; the index trade is entered at the next session close and held a month, so the claim is diffusion over weeks, not a same-day lead.
pnl_gate.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_OR_STRUCTURAL_PRES: An information-diffusion speed gap between the commodity and equity clienteles; no private information.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_COST_SURVIVABILITY: One index position change a month at 1 bp per side with a 5 bp stress rung: under 1.2 %/yr at stress.
pnl_gate.WHAT_DECISION_THIS_EXPERIMENT_WILL_CHANG: Decides whether ANY month-scale diffusion from commodities into equity indices survives this estate's evidence discipline; a failure closes the commodity-to-equity lead-lag lane and moves cross-market capacity to structural flows.
pnl_gate.SUCCESS_PATH_TO_CAPITAL: Qualify on 1993-2012 (SPY total return begins 1993-01-29) under the canonical scorer against a volatility-matched passive long, confirm on the untouched 2013-2026 window, human-gated prospective registration; R51 and R50 only after forward evidence.
pnl_gate.KILL_RULE: Kill if the frozen negative-sign monthly book has NW t < 2.0 or a net increment over a volatility-matched passive long below 1.5 %/yr; or its increment after ALSO controlling for a prior-month SPY reversal book has t < 2.0 (the census showed the oil shock moving with the same month's SPY return at +0.54 in 2006-2012, so diffusion must be separated from index reversal); or the sign disagrees between 1993-2005 and 2006-2012; or it fails BH q=0.10 with the inherited R33/R34 and R63 cross-asset tests at p=1; or the effect depends on 2008 (leave-2008-out t < 1.0).
pnl_gate.TIME_OR_DATA_BUDGET: One and a half working days; owned Norgate ICE Brent continuous futures (&BRN with &BRN_CCB, roll-free) and SPY total return; $0.
pnl_gate.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATIVE: CROSS_MARKET_PREDICTION_R33_R34 pooled many markets into a machine prediction and never preregistered this one clientele-diffusion channel with a frozen sign; R63's cross-asset transmission was a composite conditioner inside MACRO_TIMING_LANES_R63; INVENTORY_SURPRISE_EIA was a short-horizon energy reaction to inventory releases; EQUITY_INDEX_CROSS_ASSET_CARRY_R64 ranked equity-index and cross-asset futures by their own dated-contract carry slope, which is a premium, not the diffusion of a commodity shock. None tested a monthly oil shock into the equity index.

mechanisms.title: Intra-industry information transfer: early reporters' announcement reactions predict late reporters before they announce

pnl_gate.PNL_MECHANISM: When the first firms in an industry report, their announcement-window returns reveal industry-wide demand and cost news, but firms in the same industry that have not yet reported are repriced only partially until their own announcement. A long-short book of not-yet-reporting firms ranked by the size-weighted announcement reaction of already-reported peers earns the delayed repricing (Thomas and Zhang 2008).
pnl_gate.WHY_MISPRICING_SHOULD_EXIST: Investor and analyst attention is firm-specific during earnings season; those covering the late reporter under-react to peers' news until the late reporter's own event forces the update.
pnl_gate.WHY_IT_SHOULD_STILL_EXIST_WHEN_TRADABLE: The peer reaction is measured from acceptance-timestamped filings and closing prices already public, the late reporter is entered at the next close and exited before its own expected announcement window, so the trade harvests diffusion still incomplete at a legitimate entry; the kill rule tests whether it is already complete.
pnl_gate.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_OR_STRUCTURAL_PRES: Information-diffusion speed across firms within an industry; no private information.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_HOLDING_HORIZON: From the session after the peer signal to two sessions before the non-reporter's expected announcement, capped at 20 sessions.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_COST_SURVIVABILITY: Equity desk rate 12.5 bp per side on an event book of about four seasons a year with one round trip per name per season: roughly 1 %/yr of NAV per unit of gross turnover.
pnl_gate.WHAT_DECISION_THIS_EXPERIMENT_WILL_CHANG: Decides whether earnings information that is already priced for its OWN issuer is still unpriced for its PEERS; failure closes the within-equity information-transfer lane and confirms the estate's event information is spent at publication everywhere it touches.
pnl_gate.SUCCESS_PATH_TO_CAPITAL: Qualify on 2010-2019 under the canonical scorer with the incumbent and price-state controls, confirm on the untouched 2020-2026 window, human-gated registration; R51 and R50 only after forward evidence.
pnl_gate.KILL_RULE: Kill if the signed rank IC t < 2.0 or the incremental net return over the incumbent is below 1.5 %/yr at 12.5 bp; or the late reporters' move is already complete by the session after the peer signal (priced before entry); or it fails BH q=0.10 inheriting the own-issuer earnings and 8-K event cells at p=1; or the industry assignment would require classification data from after the decision date.
pnl_gate.TIME_OR_DATA_BUDGET: Five working days; owned SEC submissions acceptance instants (R63), owned XBRL fiscal periods and owned Norgate PIT prices; current industry classification only, disclosed as a look-ahead caveat; $0.
pnl_gate.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATIVE: EARNINGS_EVENT_REACTION_SUE, EVENT_8K_ITEM_CODES and INSIDER_FORM4_ALL scored an issuer's OWN event against its OWN return and found the information spent at publication, and r46_5_pead_announcement_return_20d is the issuer's own post-announcement drift; this tests the unexposed PEERS, a different information object, and its kill rule contains exactly the priced-before-entry test those families failed. NEWS_INTENSITY_SENTIMENT was article volume, not peer announcements.

mechanisms.title: Treasury auction supply concession: dealers absorbing scheduled issuance cheapen the auctioned tenor before the auction

pnl_gate.PNL_MECHANISM: The Treasury sells a pre-announced size of a specific tenor on a fixed date regardless of price, and primary dealers must bid and then warehouse the supply until end investors absorb it. To be paid for that inventory risk, the auctioned tenor cheapens in the sessions before the auction and recovers after it (Lou, Yan and Zhang 2013). The P&L is a DV01-matched short in the matched-tenor Treasury future from five sessions before the auction to the auction-day close.
pnl_gate.WHY_MISPRICING_SHOULD_EXIST: The issuer is price-insensitive and dealer balance sheets are limited, so the market-clearing price of a scheduled supply shock includes an inventory-risk concession that dealers extract from end investors who arrive later.
pnl_gate.WHY_IT_SHOULD_STILL_EXIST_WHEN_TRADABLE: Auction dates and sizes are announced about a week ahead (TreasuryDirect announcementDate), so the position is taken only after the announcement is public; the concession is compensation for bearing inventory risk that capital-limited dealers cannot arbitrage away, not an informational edge that disappears once known.
pnl_gate.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_OR_STRUCTURAL_PRES: Structural supply pressure from a price-insensitive issuer intermediated by balance-sheet-constrained dealers.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_HOLDING_HORIZON: Five sessions ending at the auction-day close, one position per auction, overlapping auctions netted by tenor.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_COST_SURVIVABILITY: Treasury futures cost 1-2 bp per side in the R38 per-market model; about 150 coupon auctions a year across 2y to 30y at one round trip each is under 3 %/yr of notional at 1 bp, so the concession must exceed that on DV01-matched notional.
pnl_gate.WHAT_DECISION_THIS_EXPERIMENT_WILL_CHANG: Decides whether a forced-supply flow in rates - the estate's least-searched structural channel, uncorrelated with every equity signal and with the live skew candidate - can carry after-cost P&L; success opens an independent RATES_FUTURES return source, failure closes issuer-supply timing and down-weights the forced-flow class through the measured class multiplier.
pnl_gate.SUCCESS_PATH_TO_CAPITAL: Qualify on 2000-2016 auctions under the canonical scorer, confirm on the untouched 2017-2026 auctions, human-gated prospective registration of the auction-calendar rule into the existing TRUE_FORWARD machinery; R51 governance and R50 allocation only after forward evidence.
pnl_gate.KILL_RULE: Kill if the per-auction DV01-matched short book has NW t < 2.0 or net below 1.5 %/yr at the R38 per-market cost (2 bp per side); or the concession is already complete between announcement and entry (announcement-to-entry return carries the whole effect); or the 5y/10y/30y tenor legs disagree in sign; or it fails BH q=0.10 at m=1 with PRIMARY_DEALER_POSITIONS and RATES_CARRY_CURVE_RV inherited at p=1.
pnl_gate.TIME_OR_DATA_BUDGET: Three working days; free TreasuryDirect auction history API (announcement, auction and issue dates and offering amounts, 1980+), owned R38 native Treasury futures with real roll dates and per-market costs; $0.
pnl_gate.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATIVE: No estate test ever used the Treasury auction calendar (sweep 2026-09-13: every auction hit was an equity opening or closing auction). PRIMARY_DEALER_POSITIONS used one market-wide weekly positions series that could not rank markets and RATES_CARRY_CURVE_RV traded carry and curve slope; neither timed a scheduled supply event. MACRO_EVENT_ANNOUNCEMENT_REACTION_R44_R45 was a minutes-scale reaction to data releases, not issuance.

mechanisms.title: Month-end rebalancing by balanced funds and pensions: the asset class that outperformed month to date is sold into the month end

census_before_returns.computed: signal-only: month-to-date equity-minus-bond return at the close before the window, and data validation of the futures series; no window or forward return was computed
census_before_returns.data_trap_found: Norgate &ES/&ZN are the UNADJUSTED front continuation and &ES_CCB/&ZN_CCB are difference back-adjusted (ZN_CCB goes negative); ZN rolls in the last sessions of Feb/May/Aug/Nov, inside the window, so leg returns are declared as the change in the _CCB close divided by the prior unadjusted close, with a data gate against SPY and IEF total return
census_before_returns.entry_correction: the spread is entered at the close AFTER the signal close, never at the close that defines the signal

pnl_gate.PNL_MECHANISM: Pension, target-date and balanced funds hold fixed policy weights in equities and bonds and restore them near each month end. When equities have outperformed bonds month to date, their mandated selling of equities and buying of bonds pushes the equity-minus-bond return negative over the last sessions of the month, and the reverse after equities underperform (Harvey, Mazzoleni and Melone 2025). The P&L is an ES-versus-ZN spread signed against the month-to-date relative return and held over the rebalancing window.
pnl_gate.WHY_MISPRICING_SHOULD_EXIST: The rebalancers are rule-bound and price-insensitive by mandate, their trade size scales with a relative return everyone can observe, and the flow is concentrated in a few sessions, so liquidity providers demand a concession to absorb it.
pnl_gate.WHY_IT_SHOULD_STILL_EXIST_WHEN_TRADABLE: The month-to-date relative return is measured at a close and the spread is entered at the NEXT close, so the forecast uses only realised prices and never trades at the price that defines it; the flow is a mandate rather than an information-driven trade, and its existence does not require anyone to be uninformed.
pnl_gate.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_OR_STRUCTURAL_PRES: Structural, mandate-driven rebalancing pressure; no information advantage.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_HOLDING_HORIZON: The last three sessions of each calendar month through the first session of the next month, about four sessions.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_COST_SURVIVABILITY: Two futures legs once a month at 1 bp per side per leg with a 5 bp stress rung: under 2.4 %/yr at stress.
pnl_gate.WHAT_DECISION_THIS_EXPERIMENT_WILL_CHANG: Decides whether the month-end calendar effects the estate already closed failed because they ignored the flow's SIGN; if the signed spread pays after costs it is an equity-bond return source independent of every signal the estate holds, and if it fails the month-end flow channel is closed in both unconditional and conditional forms.
pnl_gate.SUCCESS_PATH_TO_CAPITAL: Qualify on 1998-2014 under the canonical scorer against the unconditional month-end spread, confirm on the untouched 2015-2026 window, human-gated prospective registration; R51 and R50 only after forward evidence.
pnl_gate.KILL_RULE: Kill if the signed window book has NW t < 2.0 or net below 1.5 %/yr at 1 bp per side per leg; or its increment over the UNCONDITIONAL month-end spread has t < 2.0 (then it is the closed calendar effect); or the sign disagrees between quarter-end and other months; or it fails BH q=0.10 inheriting R32_EVENT_DRIVEN_CALENDAR and r46_3_spx_turn_of_month at p=1.
pnl_gate.TIME_OR_DATA_BUDGET: Two working days; owned Norgate ES and ZN continuous futures with SPY and IEF total return as a cross-check; $0.
pnl_gate.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATIVE: R32_EVENT_DRIVEN_CALENDAR tested unconditional turn-of-month, quarter-end and witching dummies on index exposure, SAME_MONTH_SEASONALITY was a per-name month-of-year return, and r46_3_spx_turn_of_month is a live forward challenger on the unconditional SPX window; none signs a position by the month-to-date equity-versus-bond return that sizes the mandated flow, and the kill rule demands an increment over the unconditional month-end effect so the closed dummy cannot pass under a new name.

owned: Norgate &ES and &ZN continuous futures (R57 futures panel)

mechanisms.title: Commodity index roll pressure: index funds sell the nearby contract and buy the next on a published schedule

census_before_returns.computed: contract identity only: the business day of the month on which the R38 native layer's held dated contract changes; no price return
census_before_returns.deferred_return_coverage: ret2 present on 0.93-1.00 of sessions in every market
census_before_returns.universe_declared_before_returns: markets whose layer roll falls after business day 10 in at least 95 % of months (HO, RB, NG, GC, SI, HG, PL, PA, ZC, ZS, ZW, KE, ZL, ZM, KC, SB, CT): during the GSCI/BCOM window their held contract is the nearby being sold and ret2 the deferred being bought; CL, BRN, HE (roll inside the window), GAS, LE (roll before it) and CC, GF (mixed) are excluded
census_before_returns.caveat: the layer's deferred contract is the next LISTED contract, which for metals may be a serial month the index skips; the spread is declared as a proxy for nearby-minus-next, not the exact index pair

pnl_gate.PNL_MECHANISM: Commodity index funds tracking the S&P GSCI and the Bloomberg Commodity Index must sell nearby contracts and buy the next contracts over published business days each month (GSCI days 5-9, BCOM days 6-10). That predictable, price-insensitive spread flow cheapens the nearby leg relative to the next leg during the window; a calendar spread positioned before the window and closed at its end earns the pressure (Mou 2011; Bessembinder, Carrion, Tuttle and Venkataraman 2016).
pnl_gate.WHY_MISPRICING_SHOULD_EXIST: Index replicators disclose their schedule and trade regardless of price; liquidity providers who absorb large spread flow on known days charge for it in the spread.
pnl_gate.WHY_IT_SHOULD_STILL_EXIST_WHEN_TRADABLE: The schedule and contract months are public years ahead, so the only question is whether the concession still exceeds two-leg spread costs after a decade of front-running; entry uses only the calendar and closing prices.
pnl_gate.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_OR_STRUCTURAL_PRES: Structural, schedule-driven forced spread trading by passive index funds.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_HOLDING_HORIZON: From the close two sessions before the index roll window to the close of its last day, about seven sessions a month per rolled market.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_COST_SURVIVABILITY: Two legs per market per month at the R38 per-market cost (2-15 bp per side); about twelve round trips a year per market in the liquid energy, metals and grain roll markets, which the concession must beat after per-market costs.
pnl_gate.WHAT_DECISION_THIS_EXPERIMENT_WILL_CHANG: Decides whether a forced index-fund roll flow in commodities still pays after costs; success opens a commodity return source independent of carry and trend, failure closes schedule-driven roll pressure and lowers the forced-flow class weight.
pnl_gate.SUCCESS_PATH_TO_CAPITAL: Qualify on 1995-2014 with per-market costs under the canonical scorer, confirm on the untouched 2015-2026 window, human-gated prospective registration; R51 and R50 only after forward evidence.
pnl_gate.KILL_RULE: Kill if the window spread book across roll markets has NW t < 2.0 or net below 1.5 %/yr after R38 per-market costs; or it is carried by one market (leave-one-market-out t < 1.0); or the post-2010 half has the opposite sign of the pre-2010 half; or it fails BH q=0.10 inheriting CALENDAR_TERM_STRUCTURE_ROLL_STATE_R59 and COMMODITY_CURVE_CARRY_SPREADS at p=1.
pnl_gate.TIME_OR_DATA_BUDGET: Four working days; owned R38 native dated-contract layer (held and deferred contract prices, real roll dates, per-market costs, 69 markets 1987-2026) and the published GSCI and BCOM roll calendars; $0.
pnl_gate.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATIVE: CALENDAR_TERM_STRUCTURE_ROLL_STATE_R59 scored each market's OWN roll flags and dated-contract slope (carry), not the index funds' published roll window; COMMODITY_CURVE_CARRY_SPREADS and INTER_COMMODITY_RV_SEASONALITY traded curve shape and seasonal relative value; VX_TERM_CARRY was volatility-futures roll-down; SAME_MONTH_SEASONALITY was a per-name month-of-year stock return, not a published business-day trading schedule of index replicators. No estate test used the GSCI or BCOM roll schedule (sweep 2026-09-13).

free_acquisition: S&P GSCI and BCOM published roll calendars (methodology documents)

mechanisms.title: Bond index month-end duration extension: benchmarked funds buy long Treasuries when the index adds newly issued long bonds

pnl_gate.PNL_MECHANISM: Bond index providers add newly issued Treasuries to the index only at month end, so passive and benchmarked funds must buy duration on the last session of months in which long-tenor supply was heavy. That predictable demand should lift long-Treasury returns into the month end in proportion to the duration the index adds. The P&L is a long bond-futures position over the last two sessions of months ranked high on duration added by that month's settled issuance.
pnl_gate.WHY_MISPRICING_SHOULD_EXIST: Benchmarked bond managers are penalised for tracking error, so they buy the extension at the index rebalancing close regardless of price; the size of the extension is computable from settled issuance before the month ends.
pnl_gate.WHY_IT_SHOULD_STILL_EXIST_WHEN_TRADABLE: The duration added is known from settled auctions before the window and entry is at the close two sessions before month end; the demand is benchmark-driven and recurs every month whether or not anyone anticipates it.
pnl_gate.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_OR_STRUCTURAL_PRES: Structural, benchmark-mandated duration demand at a known date.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_HOLDING_HORIZON: The last two sessions of the month.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_COST_SURVIVABILITY: One bond-futures round trip a month at 1-2 bp per side with a 5 bp stress rung: under 1.2 %/yr at stress.
pnl_gate.WHAT_DECISION_THIS_EXPERIMENT_WILL_CHANG: Decides whether benchmark-driven duration demand is a tradable rates return source separate from the auction-supply concession; if both Treasury flow mechanisms fail, forced Treasury supply-and-demand timing is closed.
pnl_gate.SUCCESS_PATH_TO_CAPITAL: Qualify on 2000-2016 under the canonical scorer against an unconditional month-end long, confirm on the untouched 2017-2026 window, human-gated registration; R51 and R50 only after forward evidence.
pnl_gate.KILL_RULE: Kill if the extension-ranked month-end long book has NW t < 2.0 or net below 1.5 %/yr at the R38 per-market cost (2 bp per side); or its increment over an unconditional month-end long of the same futures has NW t < 2.0; or it fails BH q=0.10 over m=3 with R32_EVENT_DRIVEN_CALENDAR and TREASURY_AUCTION_SUPPLY_CONCESSION_V1 inherited at p=1.
pnl_gate.TIME_OR_DATA_BUDGET: Three working days; free TreasuryDirect issuance history for duration added and owned R38 or Norgate bond futures; paid index-extension estimates are NOT used; $0.
pnl_gate.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATIVE: R32_EVENT_DRIVEN_CALENDAR used unconditional turn-of-month and quarter-end dummies on equity exposure; no estate test sized a bond position by the duration that settled issuance adds to the index. It shares the issuance calendar with TREASURY_AUCTION_SUPPLY_CONCESSION_V1 but trades the opposite side of the flow: benchmark demand after settlement, not dealer supply before the auction.

owned: R38 native Treasury futures (TY, US) and Norgate continuous bond futures
free_acquisition: TreasuryDirect TA_WS auction and issue history

mechanisms.title: Informed trading in single-name options: a steep put smirk and implied-volatility spread predict the underlying stock

pnl_gate.PNL_MECHANISM: Traders with negative private information prefer out-of-the-money puts for leverage, so a steep single-name put smirk and a put-call implied-volatility spread reveal informed positioning before the stock price adjusts (Xing, Zhang and Zhao 2010; Cremers and Weinbaum 2010). A weekly long-short book of S&P 500 stocks ranked by smirk and implied-volatility spread earns the subsequent adjustment.
pnl_gate.WHY_MISPRICING_SHOULD_EXIST: Options offer leverage and hide intent, so informed demand shows up first in option prices, and stock investors who do not watch option markets price the information with a delay.
pnl_gate.WHY_IT_SHOULD_STILL_EXIST_WHEN_TRADABLE: End-of-day implied volatilities are observable after the close and the stock is entered at the next close; the documented predictability lasts weeks, so a one-session delay forgoes only part of it.
pnl_gate.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_OR_STRUCTURAL_PRES: The derivatives market leads the cash market for informed downside information.
pnl_gate.EXPECTED_COST_SURVIVABILITY: Equity desk 12.5 bp per side on a weekly cross-sectional book with turnover near 40 % a week costs about 5 %/yr, so the gross spread must exceed roughly 7 %/yr.
pnl_gate.WHAT_DECISION_THIS_EXPERIMENT_WILL_CHANG: Decides whether the live SPY skew mechanism has a cross-sectional, diversifiable counterpart worth buying data for; it is the highest-value unowned information in the derivatives domain and the human purchase decision depends on its priced purchase case.
pnl_gate.SUCCESS_PATH_TO_CAPITAL: Human purchase gate first; then preregistered qualification on the purchased window, untouched confirmation, human-gated prospective registration; R51 and R50 only after forward evidence.
pnl_gate.KILL_RULE: Before purchase: stop if the priced cost of three or more years of S&P 500 end-of-day near-the-money chains implies a break-even alpha above 3.5 %/yr at the paper NAV (EXTREME_HURDLE). After purchase: kill if the signed rank IC t < 2.0 or the net increment over the incumbent is below 1.5 %/yr at 12.5 bp.
pnl_gate.TIME_OR_DATA_BUDGET: Purchase-case pricing only: free vendor metadata cost queries for OPRA end-of-day chains, no download, no subscription; the human purchase gate decides.
pnl_gate.WHY_NOT_DUPLICATIVE: Only ever a paid gap: every owned option dataset is the SPY surface (SPY_OPTION_SURFACE_CELLS, R44_SPY_RISK_REVERSAL_VRP) or the live REVERSED_SPY_PUT_CALL_SKEW_H5_NEXT_OPEN_V1, and VX_CONDITIONAL_SHORT_VOL_R41 conditioned index-level VX futures spreads on VVIX and SKEW states; no single-name option information was ever tested with owned data.
